coach_text:
Good (12): Contact not above your head; Ball bounced close enough; Body sideways in preparation; Contact in front of the body; Early preparation; Left arm tracks the ball; Load the legs (squat); Stable base; Racquet drops below the ball; Low-to-high swing (topspin); Legs drive up into the ball; Finish over the left shoulder.
To improve on your next forehands (5, most important first):
1. [Footwork] At contact your right foot is in front of your left. Step in with the LEFT foot so your weight transfers forward through the ball.
2. [Contact] You are hitting the ball too low - bend your knees to get down to it or take it a little earlier.
3. [Contact] Give yourself room: meet the ball about an arm's length to your right, not jammed into the body or at full stretch.
4. [Contact] Keep your head still and your eyes on the contact point until the ball has left the strings.
5. [Finish] Stay balanced: at the finish your head should be over your feet, not falling away.
Could not measure (1): Arm not cramped at contact (film a little closer, steady, with the ball in view).
serve_kpis: contact, same as the manual check
serve_readout: 10 of 15 checks good; 3 fixes in priority order - shoulders tilted up to the ball; toss arm stays up; land inside the court.
fh_readout: hitting point at 1.67 m, 13 of 18 checks good; fix: contact in front of the body; room between body and ball; early preparation; stable base.
